Practice is the planned set of practice problems and autograded checks
generated from each concept's source (VISION.md section 1).

## Purpose

Students check their understanding against problems that agree with the
figures and animations, because all of them come from the same source.

## Constraints

Practice is designed so that student records never enter a repository
(VISION.md section 3). It is not a learning management system (section 1).

## Status

Not started: Phase 2, Interaction (VISION.md section 6).
